content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to add two analog inputs in a function block using mathematical operations, but I am unable to access the reference tags, even though I used the amplifier instruction. The same issue occurs when trying this in a ladder diagram. Can someone explain why this is happening and suggest a solution? Thank you. [user_name]

Directly below the function block, you will find a small gray button. Clicking on it with your mouse will provide the reference. Let me know if this resolves your issue; otherwise, I can create a sample program for you. Also, make sure to use an analog amplifier after the analog input, as only this amplifier can provide the needed reference signals.
You might find helpful information on this website: How do you configure references between blocks in [product_name] [version_no]? [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble accessing reference tags in mathematics instructions when working with analog inputs and function blocks. Attempts to resolve this by including the amplifier instruction have been unsuccessful, both in function block configuration and ladder diagram. Community members advise ensuring a specific analog amplifier is used, and interacting properly with UI components is crucial to access references.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to add analog inputs to mathematics instructions and have the appropriate reference tags automatically available, particularly after using the amplifier instruction.
